description.content: Create a lead ads webhook subscription. Subscriptions allow Pinterest to deliver lead data from Ads Manager directly to the subscriber. Subscriptions can exist for a specific lead form or at ad account level. - Only requests for the OWNER or ADMIN of the ad_account will be allowed. - Advertisers can set up multiple integrations using ad_account_id + lead_form_id but only one integration per unique records. - For data security, egress lead data is encrypted with AES-256-GCM. This endpoint is currently in beta and not available to all apps. Learn more.
